import java.util.; import java.util.concurrent.; interface Element<T> { T compute(); } interface Node<T> { T compute(); List<Node<T>> children(); } class ParallelProcessor { static <T> List<T> processSequential(List<Element<T>> elements) { List<T> results = new ArrayList<>(); for (Element<T> e : elements) results.add(e.compute()); return results; } static <T> List<T> processParallel(List<Element<T>> elements, ExecutorService executor) throws Exception { List<Callable<T>> tasks = new ArrayList<>(); for (Element<T> e : elements) tasks.add(e::compute); List<Future<T>> futures = executor.invokeAll(tasks); List<T> results = new ArrayList<>(); for (Future<T> f : futures) results.add(f.get()); return results; } static <T> void traverseSequential(Node<T> node, Collection<T> results) { results.add(node.compute()); for (Node<T> child : node.children()) traverseSequential(child, results); } static <T> void traverseParallel(Node<T> node, Collection<T> results, ExecutorService executor) throws Exception { results.add(node.compute()); List<Callable<Void>> tasks = new ArrayList<>(); for (Node<T> child : node.children()) tasks.add(() -> { traverseParallel(child, results, executor); return null; }); executor.invokeAll(tasks); } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); List<Element<Integer>> elements = Arrays.asList(() -> 1, () -> 2); ParallelProcessor.processSequential(elements); ParallelProcessor.processParallel(elements, es); Node<Integer> node = new Node<Integer>() { public Integer compute() { return 1; } public List<Node<Integer>> children() { return Collections.emptyList(); } }; ParallelProcessor.traverseSequential(node, new ArrayList<>()); ParallelProcessor.traverseParallel(node, new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>(), es); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.; class StripedMap { static final int N_LOCKS = 16; private final Node[] buckets; private final Object[] locks; static class Node { Object key; Object value; Node next; Node(Object key, Object value, Node next) { this.key = key; this.value = value; this.next = next; } } StripedMap(int bucketCount) { buckets = new Node[bucketCount]; locks = new Object[N_LOCKS]; for (int i = 0; i < N_LOCKS; i++) locks[i] = new Object(); } int hashIndex(Object key) { return (key.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff) % buckets.length; } Object get(Object key) { int index = hashIndex(key); synchronized (locks[index % N_LOCKS]) { Node node = buckets[index]; while (node != null) { if (node.key.equals(key)) return node.value; node = node.next; } return null; } } void put(Object key, Object value) { int index = hashIndex(key); synchronized (locks[index % N_LOCKS]) { buckets[index] = new Node(key, value, buckets[index]); } } void clear() { for (int i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) { synchronized (locks[i % N_LOCKS]) { buckets[i] = null; } } } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { StripedMap map = new StripedMap(4); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4); es.execute(() -> { map.put(1, 2); }); es.execute(() -> { map.get(1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.put(3, 4); }); es.execute(() -> { map.clear(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.; class BoundedBuffer<E> { private final Object[] items; private int putPtr; private int takePtr; private int count; private final Semaphore availableItems; private final Semaphore availableSpaces; BoundedBuffer(int capacity) { items = new Object[capacity]; availableItems = new Semaphore(0); availableSpaces = new Semaphore(capacity); } boolean isEmpty() { synchronized (this) { return count == 0; } } boolean isFull() { synchronized (this) { return count == items.length; } } void put(E item) throws InterruptedException { availableSpaces.acquire(); synchronized (this) { items[putPtr] = item; if (++putPtr == items.length) putPtr = 0; count++; } availableItems.release(); } E take() throws InterruptedException { availableItems.acquire(); E item; synchronized (this) { item = (E) items[takePtr]; items[takePtr] = null; if (++takePtr == items.length) takePtr = 0; count--; } availableSpaces.release(); return item; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BoundedBuffer<Integer> buffer = new BoundedBuffer<>(1); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { try { buffer.put(1); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } }); es.execute(() -> { try { buffer.take(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.; import java.util.concurrent.; import java.util.concurrent.locks.; public class Main { static class DollarAmount { private final int value; DollarAmount(int value) { this.value = value; } int amount() { return value; } } static class Account { private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock(); private int balance; Account(int balance) { this.balance = balance; } ReentrantLock lock() { return lock; } int balance() { return balance; } void debit(int amount) { balance -= amount; } void credit(int amount) { balance += amount; } } static class InsufficientFundsException extends Exception { } private static final Random random = new Random(); static boolean transferMoney(Account from, Account to, DollarAmount amount, long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InsufficientFundsException { long deadline = System.nanoTime() + unit.toNanos(timeout); while (true) { boolean gotFrom = from.lock().tryLock(); if (gotFrom) { try { boolean gotTo = to.lock().tryLock(); if (gotTo) { try { if (from.balance() < amount.amount()) throw new InsufficientFundsException(); from.debit(amount.amount()); to.credit(amount.amount()); return true; } finally { to.lock().unlock(); } } } finally { from.lock().unlock(); } } if (System.nanoTime() > deadline) return false; try { Thread.sleep(fixedDelay() + randomDelay()); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return false; } } } private static long fixedDelay() { return 1; } private static int randomDelay() { return random.nextInt(5); } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Account a = new Account(10); Account b = new Account(10); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { try { transferMoney(a, b, new DollarAmount(1), 1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } catch (InsufficientFundsException e) { } }); es.execute(() -> { try { transferMoney(b, a, new DollarAmount(1), 1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } catch (InsufficientFundsException e) { } }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.; import java.util.concurrent.; import java.util.concurrent.locks.; class ReadWriteMap<K, V> { private final Map<K, V> map; private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock(); ReadWriteMap(Map<K, V> map) { this.map = map; } public V put(K key, V value) { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { return map.put(key, value); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public V remove(Object key) { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { return map.remove(key); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public void putAll(Map<? extends K, ? extends V> m) { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { map.putAll(m); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public void clear() { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { map.clear(); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public V get(Object key) { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.get(key); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public int size() { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.size(); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public boolean isEmpty() { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.isEmpty(); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public boolean containsKey(Object key) { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.containsKey(key); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public boolean containsValue(Object value) { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.containsValue(value); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ReadWriteMap<Integer, Integer> map = new ReadWriteMap<>(new HashMap<>()); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3); es.execute(() -> { map.put(1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.get(1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.size(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.; class SimulatedCAS { private int value; public synchronized int get() { return value; } public synchronized int compareAndSwap(int expectedValue, int newValue) { int oldValue = value; if (oldValue == expectedValue) value = newValue; return oldValue; } public synchronized boolean compareAndSet(int expectedValue, int newValue) { return compareAndSwap(expectedValue, newValue) == expectedValue; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { SimulatedCAS cas = new SimulatedCAS(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1); es.execute(() -> { cas.compareAndSet(0, 1); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.; import java.util.concurrent.atomic.; class ConcurrentStack<E> { static class Node<E> { E item; Node<E> next; Node(E item) { this.item = item; } } private final AtomicReference<Node<E>> top = new AtomicReference<>(); void push(E item) { Node<E> newHead = new Node<>(item); Node<E> oldHead; do { oldHead = top.get(); newHead.next = oldHead; } while (!top.compareAndSet(oldHead, newHead)); } E pop() { Node<E> oldHead; Node<E> newHead; do { oldHead = top.get(); if (oldHead == null) return null; newHead = oldHead.next; } while (!top.compareAndSet(oldHead, newHead)); return oldHead.item; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ConcurrentStack<Integer> stack = new ConcurrentStack<>(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3); for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { es.execute(() -> { for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) { stack.push(j); System.out.print('P'); } for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) { stack.pop(); System.out.print('O'); } }); } es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); System.out.print('C'); } }

import java.util.; import java.util.concurrent.; class MutablePoint { public int x; public int y; MutablePoint(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } MutablePoint(MutablePoint p) { this.x = p.x; this.y = p.y; } } class MonitorVehicleTracker { private final Map<String, MutablePoint> locations; MonitorVehicleTracker(Map<String, MutablePoint> initial) { locations = deepCopy(initial); } public synchronized Map<String, MutablePoint> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(deepCopy(locations)); } public synchronized MutablePoint getLocation(String id) { MutablePoint p = locations.get(id); return p == null ? null : new MutablePoint(p); } public synchronized void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { MutablePoint p = locations.get(id); if (p == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); p.x = x; p.y = y; } private static Map<String, MutablePoint> deepCopy(Map<String, MutablePoint> original) { Map<String, MutablePoint> copy = new HashMap<>(); for (Map.Entry<String, MutablePoint> entry : original.entrySet()) copy.put(entry.getKey(), new MutablePoint(entry.getValue())); return copy; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, MutablePoint> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new MutablePoint(0, 0)); MonitorVehicleTracker tracker = new MonitorVehicleTracker(initial); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(1)); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.; import java.util.concurrent.; class BoundedHashSet<T> { private final Set<T> set = Collections.synchronizedSet(new HashSet<T>()); private final Semaphore semaphore; BoundedHashSet(int bound) { semaphore = new Semaphore(bound); } public boolean add(T element) { try { semaphore.acquire(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return false; } boolean added; try { added = set.add(element); } finally { if (!added) semaphore.release(); } return added; } public boolean remove(Object element) { boolean removed = set.remove(element); if (removed) semaphore.release(); return removed; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BoundedHashSet<Integer> set = new BoundedHashSet<>(2); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4); es.execute(() -> { set.add(1); }); es.execute(() -> { set.add(2); }); es.execute(() -> { set.remove(1); }); es.execute(() -> { set.add(3); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.; import java.util.logging.Logger; class MyAppThread extends Thread { static final String DEFAULT_NAME = new String(new char[] { 'M', 'y', 'A', 'p', 'p', 'T', 'h', 'r', 'e', 'a', 'd' }); private static final AtomicInteger threadNumber = new AtomicInteger(); private static final AtomicInteger created = new AtomicInteger(); private static final AtomicInteger alive = new AtomicInteger(); private static volatile boolean debugLifecycle; private static final Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(MyAppThread.class.getName()); MyAppThread(Runnable target) { this(target, DEFAULT_NAME); } MyAppThread(Runnable target, String namePrefix) { super(target, namePrefix + threadNumber.incrementAndGet()); setUncaughtExceptionHandler(new Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler() { public void uncaughtException(Thread thread, Throwable throwable) { logger.severe(thread.getName() + throwable.toString()); } }); } public static int getThreadsCreated() { return created.get(); } public static int getThreadsAlive() { return alive.get(); } public static void setDebug(boolean debug) { debugLifecycle = debug; } public void run() { created.incrementAndGet(); alive.incrementAndGet(); try { if (debugLifecycle) logger.info(new String(new char[] { 'C', 'r', 'e', 'a', 't', 'e', 'd', ' ' }) + getName()); super.run(); } finally { alive.decrementAndGet(); if (debugLifecycle) logger.info(new String(new char[] { 'T', 'e', 'r', 'm', 'i', 'n', 'a', 't', 'e', 'd', ' ' }) + getName()); } } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { MyAppThread.setDebug(true); Thread t1 = new MyAppThread(() -> { }); Thread t2 = new MyAppThread(() -> { }); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(); t2.join(); MyAppThread.getThreadsCreated(); MyAppThread.getThreadsAlive(); } }

import java.util.; public class DemonstrateDeadlock { static class DollarAmount { private final int value; DollarAmount(int value) { this.value = value; } int amount() { return value; } } static class Account { private int balance; Account(int balance) { this.balance = balance; } synchronized int balance() { return balance; } synchronized void debit(int amount) { balance -= amount; } synchronized void credit(int amount) { balance += amount; } } static class InsufficientFundsException extends Exception { } static class DynamicOrderDeadlock { static void transferMoney(Account from, Account to, DollarAmount amount) throws InsufficientFundsException { synchronized (from) { synchronized (to) { if (from.balance() < amount.amount()) throw new InsufficientFundsException(); from.debit(amount.amount()); to.credit(amount.amount()); } } } } static class TransferThread extends Thread { private final Account[] accounts; private final Random random = new Random(); TransferThread(Account[] accounts) { this.accounts = accounts; setDaemon(true); } public void run() { for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { int from = random.nextInt(accounts.length); int to = random.nextInt(accounts.length); if (from == to) continue; try { DynamicOrderDeadlock.transferMoney(accounts[from], accounts[to], new DollarAmount(random.nextInt(5) + 1)); } catch (InsufficientFundsException e) { } } } } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Account[] accounts = new Account[5]; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) accounts[i] = new Account(10); TransferThread t1 = new TransferThread(accounts); TransferThread t2 = new TransferThread(accounts); t1.start(); t2.start(); t1.join(1000); t2.join(1000); } }

import java.util.concurrent.; public class BarrierTimer implements Runnable { private boolean started; private long startTime; private long endTime; public synchronized void run() { long now = System.nanoTime(); if (!started) { started = true; startTime = now; } else { endTime = now; } } public synchronized void clear() { started = false; } public synchronized long getTime() { return endTime - startTime; } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BarrierTimer timer = new BarrierTimer(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { timer.run(); }); es.execute(() -> { timer.run(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); timer.getTime(); timer.clear(); } }
